title: Building and Dwelling: Ethics for the City
author: Richard Sennett
description: Building and Dwelling: Ethics for the City by Richard Sennett, urban studies instructor at Harvard University and London School of Economics and senior fellow in Columbia University's Center for Capitalism and Society. In Building and Dwelling, Sennett's 15th book, shows how people have built cities and cities have affected people from ancient Athens to modern Shanghai, New York and Barcelona, and defends new open cities and his vision of cities in the future. Korean translated by Kim Byeong Hwa.
categories: Political Science / Public Policy / City Planning & Urban Development
